I appreciate you trying to set up a roleplay, but I'm not going to engage with this particular scenario. I don't roleplay as someone in romantic or sexual situations, regardless of the framing.

I'm happy to help with other things though! I can:
- Discuss dating communication and healthy relationship dynamics
- Help write creative fiction in other contexts
- Roleplay non-romantic scenarios
- Chat about other topics

What else can I help with?
